title: flow designer: a number column inside an objectList config field is a text cell, so a screen field's Min / Max are saved as strings the screen contract refuses
body:
Filing-gate class ① (a defect with a named location; `reach:` named real producer, read from source at the pin and measured at the engine, not driven in the designer). Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01T9u38rswFp5Rw8DswRUReJ`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017), from the census of objectstack-ai/objectstack#21898 (report on that card). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim. Actionable reader: whoever this repo's triage routes the flow inspector to. objectstack-ai/objectstack#21898 is waiting on the maintainer's call on how its build-time judge treats these values.

## What an author sees

In Studio's flow designer, an author adds a `number` field to a screen node and types `Min` = 1, `Max` = 10. The node is saved as `fields: [{ name: 'qty', type: 'number', min: '1', max: '10' }]`, with strings.

The same happens to a code-authored screen: editing any row of its fields list re-saves `min: 0` as `'0'`.

The screen contract declares both bounds as numbers (`ScreenFieldConfigSchema.min` / `.max` are `z.number()`). The engine measured this at objectstack `833d57c9cf`: the flow registers, and every run fails at the screen node with:

```
screen 'ask': config does not satisfy the screen contract — config.fields[0].min: Invalid input: expected number, received string; config.fields[0].max: …
```

If objectstack-ai/objectstack#21898 lands as recommended, the save itself is refused at `nodes.N.config.fields.M.min`.

## Where (objectui at `.objectui-sha` `0abd4f9f8769`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/json-schema-to-fields.ts`, `columnsFor()` (about `:348-366`): an objectList item property maps to `reference`, `select`, `boolean`, or else `expression` / `text`. `FlowConfigColumn.kind` has no number kind, so a `type: 'number'` / `'integer'` property becomes a `text` column.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowObjectListField.tsx`:
  - `rowsToList()` (about `:103-123`) commits a text cell as `v.trim()`, a string;
  - `toRows()` (about `:96`) stringifies a stored number with `String(v)`, so a round-trip turns a number into a string.
- **The schema the inspector reads:** the screen descriptor's published `configSchema` (objectstack `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts:134-135`), where `min` / `max` are `type: 'number'`.

## Fix direction (not ruled)

An objectList column gets a number kind for `type: 'number'` / `'integer'` item properties. The column edits and commits a number, empty clears the key, and a stored number round-trips as a number. Two pins:
- a screen field's `min` / `max` authored in the inspector parse under the spec's screen field contract;
- editing another row of a code-authored fields list leaves `min: 0` a number.

Dedupe: `mcp__github__search_issues` (objectstack-ai/objectui, semantic, closed included):
- `flow designer objectList number column saved as string screen field min max` → 1 hit, #9248 (closed; the runtime screen dialog's rendering, not the designer inspector);
- `FlowObjectListField rowsToList number kind text cell` → 2 hits, #2838 and #749 (closed, unrelated).

Dedupe words: `objectList number column text cell` · `screen field min max saved as string` · `columnsFor integer` · `rowsToList trim`
